task: Add optional `locked?: boolean` to BoardShape in src/board/useShapes.ts. Create src/board/lockGuard.ts exporting `export function isLocked(item: { locked?: boolean }): boolean { return item.locked === true }`. Then import isLocked in useShapes.ts and use it inside reorderShapes so that ids belonging to a locked shape are dropped from the set passed to reorder().

steps.goal: Create src/board/lockGuard.ts containing exactly the isLocked helper export.
Inspect src/board/useShapes.ts to name the exact import block, the reorderShapes symbol, and the expression passed to reorder().
steps.edit_spec: Read the whole file (it is small). Report: (a) the exact line of the last top-level import statement; (b) the exact signature line of `reorderShapes`; (c) the exact expression/argument currently passed into the `reorder(` call inside `reorderShapes`, and the name of the shapes array or id lookup available in that scope (e.g. `shapes`, `items`, `shapesRef.current`). Do not edit anything.

steps.goal: Add the optional BoardShape.locked field, import isLocked, and filter locked ids out before reorder() is called inside reorderShapes.
steps.edit_spec: Two anchored edits. (1) Immediately AFTER the last existing top-level `import ... from '...'` line at the top of the file, insert a new line: `import { isLocked } from './lockGuard'`. (2) Inside the function `reorderShapes`, immediately BEFORE the existing `reorder(` call, insert a filter that drops ids belonging to locked shapes, then pass the filtered value to `reorder(` instead of the original expression. Use the existing id-collection expression that is currently passed to `reorder(` (call it IDS) and the shape lookup already in scope in that function (call it LOOKUP, i.e. the array of shape objects such as `shapes` / `shapesRef.current`): insert `const unlockedIds = IDS.filter((id) => { const shape = LOOKUP.find((s) => s.id === id); return !(shape && isLocked(shape)); });` and change the argument of `reorder(` from IDS to `unlockedIds`. Preserve all existing indentation and do not otherwise modify reorderShapes.
